name: Repair Failed Activity
description: Analyze a failed activity execution and create a repaired variant that addresses the failure

tasks.description: Read the failed execution trace and identify the root cause
Create a repaired version of the activity that fixes the identified issue

prompt.template:
Based on the failure analysis, create a repaired variant of the activity.

Original Activity: {{activityId}}
Failure Cause: From previous analysis

Create a new activity template that:
1. Fixes the identified issue
2. Adds validation to prevent the same failure
3. Includes better error handling
4. Uses a descriptive variant ID like: {{activityId}}-repaired-001

Use the write tool to save the repaired template to:
~/.minibob/activities/repaired/{{activityId}}-{{timestamp}}.json

tasks.description: Test the repaired activity with the same inputs

prompt.template:
Test the repaired activity template to verify it works.

Repaired Template: From previous task
Original Inputs: {{originalInputs}}

Run the repaired activity and verify:
1. It completes without the previous error
2. It produces the expected output
3. Validation passes

Report the test result (success/failure) and any remaining issues.

variables.name: activityId
variables.description: ID of the activity that failed

variables.name: executionId
variables.description: Execution ID of the failed run
